notes: The agreeing articles s005 and s016 are unrepresented because English uses only one article in each noun phrase.
In “that is it which goeth,” s008 receives the expanded pronominal expression, s009 is unrepresented, and the relative pronoun accompanies s010.
In the final clause, s018 is treated as an omitted resumptive pronoun; the supplied copula is assigned to the predicate s019 under the verbless-clause rule.
